name: vasukumar92/Customer-Churn-Analysis-for-a-Telecommunications-Company
description: I have used a telecommunications dataset for predicting customer churn. This is a historical customer dataset where each row represents one customer. The data is relatively easy to understand, and you may uncover insights that can be used immediately. Typically it is less expensive to keep customers than acquire new ones, so the focus of this analysis is to predict the customers who will stay with the company. This data set provides information to help in predicting what behavior will help the company to retain customers. I have focused on analyzing all relevant customer data and develop focused customer retention programs.

name: Jeremywuwuwu/creditcarddefault-MLmodels-rf-svm-naivebayes
description: Predicting credit card default with random forest, RBF SVM and Naive Bayes on UCI data pulled through its API. Built with scikit-learn pipelines and column transformers, tuned by stratified 5-fold cross-validation, and compared using ROC-AUC, confusion matrices, McNemar's test and permutation feature importance against a majority-class baseline.

name: Jeremywuwuwu/fda-foodrecall-MLclassification
description: A two-part project predicting which FDA food recalls get Class I (most serious) status, using openFDA enforcement data. Part 1 uses structured fields and compares logistic regression with tuned XGBoost on a time-based split. Part 2 applies NLP to the recall text (reason for recall & product description) on the same splits.
